ValidationRule.description: Outcome is required when case status is closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( TEXT (Outcome__c)), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Success"),ISPICKVAL( Type , "Tier 1"),ISPICKVAL( Type , "Tier 2"),ISPICKVAL( Type , "Research"),ISPICKVAL( Type , "Retention")), RecordType.DeveloperName != "Retention" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Outcome is Required when Status is Closed
